name: Write the host surface from the Nox editor host
body: `lantern-world-editor --host-surface OUTPUT` writes the host functions the Nox host registers as a nyx-proto host surface manifest. It matches `apps/world-editor/src/ui/editor-host-surface.json`, which the C++ build writes, for every editor and `penumbra::` function. The 21 rows only C++ writes are C++ Penumbra's own types (`PenumbraWidget`, `WidgetRef` and their methods), which the editor UI doesn't use.

comments.text: The Nox host's --host-surface manifest matches the C++ one for every editor function (types the same, only parameter names differ). The 21 rows only C++ writes are C++ Penumbra's own types (PenumbraWidget, WidgetRef and their methods), which the editor UI never calls.
